local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local BuyItemRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")

while true do
    for i = 1, 18 do
        local args = {
            [1] = i, 
            [2] = 0  
        }
        
        
        BuyItemRemote:FireServer(unpack(args))
        
        
        task.wait(0.05) 
    end
    
    print("give it a sec for next burst in like 5s")
    
    
    task.wait(5) 
end
